name: zanker-root-cause-analysis
description: Trace visual defects to the responsible style, component state or runtime context.

workflow.instruction: Inspect cascade, inherited styles, font loading, intrinsic sizes, layout container and viewport.
Differentiate implementation defect from sandbox mismatch.
Fix at correct abstraction layer, then test related consumers.

fallback: Escalate to integrated-mode reproduction if sandbox lacks parity.
